en: The lease under <t1/> is the only thing the shared server writes, and it is the only thing that can go wrong between clients. Whatever it contains when the next <t2/> starts, that process gets a server: a live one is attached to, a stale one (the server was killed), a corrupt one (not a lease document), an empty one (the owner died between creating and writing it) or an abandoned one (no URL after the bind grace) is taken over, and the log says which it was. When the file cannot be written or replaced at all, or the shared server cannot start, the client is served alone exactly as <t3/> would serve it, with <t4/> and the reason in the log; only the layer's own errors turn a client away. Ctrl-C, a client killing its server, or a closing terminal remove the lease before the process dies.

Když soubor nelze vůbec zapsat ani nahradit nebo sdílený server nelze spustit, klient je obsloužen sám, přesně jak by ho obsloužil <t3/>, s <t4/> a důvodem v logu; klienta odmítnou jen chyby samotné vrstvy. en: doctor and watch compare two facts nothing else owns together: that episodes are closing, and that derivations are following them. When the newest session.closed line names an episode no knowledge.derived line names, and that close is older than session.freshness.stale_minutes, the finding is FAIL knowledge naming the episode, with the read-only reproduce and the remedy after fix:. When session.knowledge_on_end is on and the lifecycle source never calls the deriver, the finding names the source file. A derivation for that episode clears the finding.
cs: doctor a watch porovnávají dva fakty, které nevlastní nic jiného: že se epizody uzavírají a že za nimi následují odvození. Když nejnovější řádek session.closed jmenuje epizodu, kterou nejmenuje žádný řádek knowledge.derived, a toto uzavření je starší než session.freshness.stale_minutes, nález je FAIL knowledge jmenující epizodu, s read-only reprodukcí a nápravou za fix:. Když je session.knowledge_on_end zapnuto a zdroj životního cyklu deriver nikdy nevolá, nález jmenuje zdrojový soubor. Odvození pro tu epizodu nález odstraní.
